name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: A chatbot designed to assist Northstar customers with product inquiries, order status checks, and return requests.

customer_message.description: The incoming message from the customer.

order_id.description: The ID of the customer's order, if applicable.

product_name.description: The name of the product the customer is inquiring about, if applicable.

category.description: The classified category of the customer message.

final_reply.description: The composed reply that will be sent to the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies the incoming customer message into one of the predefined categories.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes the classified customer message to the appropriate handler based on its category.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks if the order ID has been provided by the customer.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Fetches the current status of the order using the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply regarding the order status to the final_reply state.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the customer to provide their order ID to proceed with the inquiry.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply for requesting the order ID to the final_reply state.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Retrieves the current return policy to inform the customer.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply regarding the return policy to the final_reply state.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks the availability of the requested product in the inventory.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply regarding stock availability to the final_reply state.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags the customer inquiry for human review if it falls outside predefined categories.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves the escalation reply for human review to the final_reply state.
